overview_description.description:
Sonic is a next-generation operating system for the food and beverage industry, built to unify and optimize every layer of restaurant operations. 
Combining POS, online ordering, call center integration, and advanced analytics into a single platform, Sonic enables operators to increase revenue, and make faster, data-driven decisions.

Designed with an offline-first architecture and seamless integration with Egypt’s eTax system, Sonic ensures reliability, compliance, and operational continuity in high-demand environments.

Backed by over 15 years of hands-on industry experience, Sonic is purpose-built for modern F&B operators—offering scalable, hardware-flexible deployment and multi-location management to support growth across chains and franchises.
